title: Clamp Table
statement: Implement `solve(values)`. Clamp each integer to the inclusive range 0 through 10. Return the list of clamped values. Bounds are fixed. Values inside stay.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A parametrized test is a table of inputs and expected outputs.

editorial: A parametrized test is a table of inputs and expected outputs. This function is the body those rows call. One implementation serves every row. A branch per test name would mean the rows are not the same behavior.
